title: Make Alpine Elixir CI pass on GitHub-hosted runners
description: GitHub Actions runs 31395719161, 31397306552, and 31397873475 exposed three container boundaries: missing Git, PostgreSQL service addressing, and OTP 27+ Alpine signal-stack failures on newer x64 runners. Make hosted CI pass with the newest supported pre-OTP-27 pair while preserving the standard x64 runner, checkout action, cache, and Alpine job environment.
acceptance_criteria: The hosted workflow completes dependency resolution and all tests using Elixir 1.19.5 / OTP 26.2.5.21 / Alpine 3.24.1; PostgreSQL is healthy and reachable; checkout and dependency caching work without errors; required Git and GNU tar packages are installed; local mix precommit passes; a separate deferred issue tracks upgrading after the upstream fix is released.
close_reason: Alpine CI now passes on GitHub-hosted x64 runners with a supported pre-OTP-27 toolchain, healthy PostgreSQL, required runtime packages, and functional dependency caching.

comments.author: jakub
comments.text: Second confirmed CI boundary: after installing Git, an isolated Alpine job simulation reached mix test and failed because config/test.exs connects to localhost:5432 while the workflow has no PostgreSQL service. GitHub's documented container-job pattern uses a postgres service label plus POSTGRES_HOST=postgres. The fix must include that service and retain localhost as the local default.

comments.author: jakub
comments.text: Verification on 2026-08-10: GitHub run 31395719161 failed because git was absent; RED workflow assertion reproduced the missing step. Installing apk git allowed mix deps.get. Exact two-container simulation with hexpm/elixir:1.20.3-erlang-29.0.5-alpine-3.24.1 and postgres:18.4-alpine3.24 completed mix deps.get and mix test with 47 passing tests. Local mix precommit passed 47 tests. Independent amended-diff review approved with no Critical, Important, or Minor findings.

title: Upgrade Alpine CI after OTP signal-stack fix release
description: After Erlang publishes a stable OTP release containing erlang/otp#11376 and HexPM publishes a compatible Alpine image, upgrade Taskman's CI to the then-current stable supported Elixir/OTP pair. Keep ubuntu-latest, actions/checkout, actions/cache, Git and GNU tar installation, and the PostgreSQL service. Reproduce the prior x64 startup path and require a successful hosted run before closing.
acceptance_criteria: A stable OTP release containing erlang/otp#11376 is available in a HexPM Alpine image; CI pins the then-current stable supported Elixir/OTP pair; ubuntu-latest, checkout, cache, Git and GNU tar installation, and PostgreSQL service remain intact; the exact x64 container topology passes locally; mix precommit passes; the GitHub-hosted workflow completes successfully without cache errors.
notes: Deferred on the external OTP release. Current compatibility baseline and failure evidence are documented in docs/specs/2026-08-10-alpine-elixir-ci-design.md.

title: Projects and basic Tasks: first vertical slice
description:
Deliver the approved first vertical slice: create and select a Project, create a default Task in a URL-backed modal, and show that Task in the selected Project direct list.

Source design: docs/specs/2026-07-18-projects-basic-tasks-first-slice-design.md.

Execution plan: docs/archive/plans/2026-07-18-projects-basic-tasks-first-slice.md.

## Success Criteria

- A user can create and select a Project for an existing local directory.
- A user can create a default Pending/None Task from a URL-backed modal.
- The selected Project direct list contains only its Tasks.
- Unknown Project URLs preserve the working sidebar.
- mix precommit and the browser acceptance smoke test pass.
close_reason: All five first-increment tasks completed, task-reviewed, whole-slice reviewed, and verified by automated and browser acceptance checks.
